column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 09 (M24009): Ullrid memimpin Doll Community mempertahankan Pradaja
# dengan taktik gerus habis peninggalan Commander; Lentine terjebak di dalamnya.
# Tetap Inggris: Ullrid, Littara, Doll Community, Commander, Mokosh, Robella,
# Mangi Security, Leva, Lenna, Kalina, Pradaja, Paradajz, Porcelain, Underground Brokers,
# Yellow Zone, Interrupter, Limonad Squad, Taren, Neural cloud, Frame, T-Doll, Lentine,
# Alpha, Operation Plan 09.
(Ever since Ullrid announced the Commander's battle situation in Mokosh, the atmosphere in the Doll Community has become as tense as a fully drawn bow.)
column2: (Sejak Ullrid mengumumkan situasi pertempuran Commander di Mokosh, suasana di Doll Community menegang seperti busur yang ditarik penuh.)

column1: (But this did not stop the Dolls from moving forward.)
column2: (Tapi itu tidak menghentikan para Doll untuk terus melangkah maju.)

column1: (As the Commander's most solid allies and backers, all members of the Doll Community had entered a state of combat readiness under Ullrid's coordination long ago.)
column2: (Sebagai sekutu dan penyokong paling kokoh bagi Commander, seluruh anggota Doll Community sudah lama masuk ke keadaan siap tempur di bawah koordinasi Ullrid.)

column1: (Therefore, to make up for the Doll Community's lack of defensive depth, Ullrid followed the Commander's pre-war deployment and established multiple defense lines in the tomato trade hub—the town of Pradaja, located 30 kilometers outside the Doll Community's thermal power plant—to ensure the community's safety.)
column2: (Karena itu, untuk menutupi kurangnya kedalaman pertahanan Doll Community, Ullrid mengikuti penempatan pra-perang dari Commander dan membangun beberapa garis pertahanan di pusat perdagangan tomat—kota Pradaja, yang terletak 30 kilometer dari pembangkit listrik termal Doll Community—demi menjamin keamanan komunitas.)

column1: Ullrid, have you received any more battle reports regarding Mokosh? — Littara
column2: Ullrid, kau menerima laporan tempur lagi soal Mokosh? — Littara

column1: No... Currently, aside from the news sent by Miss Robella, I don't know what the situation is on the Commander's side either...
column2: Tidak... Sekarang, selain kabar yang dikirim Miss Robella, aku juga tidak tahu bagaimana situasi di pihak Commander...

column1: Ah... is it still that previous warning? — Littara
column2: Ah... masih peringatan yang tadi itu? — Littara

column1: That's right.
column2: Benar.

column1: On their way to Mokosh to support the Commander, they encountered the military's advance forces. Although they successfully intercepted them, they received intel that another Mangi Security team is heading our way.
column2: Di perjalanan ke Mokosh untuk membantu Commander, mereka berhadapan dengan pasukan pendahulu militer. Meski berhasil mencegatnya, mereka menerima intel bahwa satu regu Mangi Security lain menuju ke arah kita.

column1: Also, Leva, Lenna, and Miss Kalina are on their way to support us.
column2: Selain itu, Leva, Lenna, dan Miss Kalina sedang menuju kemari untuk membantu kita.

column1: Directly attacking the Doll Community... — Littara
column2: Menyerang Doll Community secara langsung... — Littara

column1: ...We were treated as a support rear that must be targeted, and in fact, that is indeed the case.
column2: ...Kita dianggap sebagai basis dukungan yang harus dihabisi, dan kenyataannya memang begitu.

column1: Our contingency plans were not sufficient... whether it was that time we were attacked by Mangi Security, or during Mokosh...
column2: Rencana daruratku belum memadai... baik waktu kita diserang Mangi Security, maupun saat Mokosh...

column1: I was too careless. I should have taken this into consideration long ago...
column2: Aku terlalu lengah. Aku seharusnya sudah memperhitungkan ini sejak lama...

column1: (Ullrid grips the armrests of her chair tightly, the noise in her Neural cloud roaring like thunder, but immediately feels a softness covering the back of her hand.)
column2: (Ullrid mencengkeram kuat sandaran tangan kursinya, derau di Neural cloud-nya menggelegar seperti guntur, tapi seketika dia merasakan sesuatu yang lembut menutupi punggung tangannya.)

column1: (She looks up slightly and sees a squishy toy resting on the back of her hand.)
column2: (Dia mengangkat wajah sedikit dan melihat sebuah mainan kenyal tergeletak di punggung tangannya.)

column1: (Ullrid instinctively lets go of the armrest and grabs the squishy toy backhanded.)
column2: (Secara refleks Ullrid melepas sandaran tangannya dan menangkap mainan kenyal itu dengan tangan terbalik.)

column1: (Squish, squish... squish, squish—)
column2: (Pluk, pluk... pluk, pluk—)

column1: Phew—
column2: Fyuh—

column1: (The noise in her Neural cloud seems to slowly dissolve into the soft touch of the squishy toy.)
column2: (Derau di Neural cloud-nya seolah perlahan larut ke dalam sentuhan lembut mainan kenyal itu.)

column1: Although we couldn't completely avoid the risks, we have established a shadow of the Doll Community here according to the Commander's deployment. — Littara
column2: Meski risikonya tidak bisa dihindari sepenuhnya, kita sudah membangun bayangan Doll Community di sini sesuai penempatan Commander. — Littara

column1: With the foreign trade exports over these past few months and everyone's deliberate guidance, people on the outside all think our main base is this Pradaja. — Littara
column2: Dengan ekspor perdagangan luar beberapa bulan ini dan pengarahan yang sengaja dibuat semua orang, orang di luar semuanya menganggap markas utama kita adalah Pradaja ini. — Littara

column1: And Pradaja's defense lines are already prepared... Everyone is following your orders, working together to deal with this crisis. — Littara
column2: Dan garis pertahanan Pradaja sudah siap... Semua orang mengikuti perintahmu, bekerja bersama menghadapi krisis ini. — Littara

column1: Our tactical squads are also up and running. You've done very well, Ullrid. — Littara
column2: Regu taktis kita juga sudah berjalan. Kau sudah melakukannya dengan sangat baik, Ullrid. — Littara

column1: Very well...? Even if this isn't our true main base, as long as this place is breached... it's only a matter of time before Mangi Security finds the thermal power plant...
column2: Sangat baik...? Meski ini bukan markas utama kita yang sebenarnya, begitu tempat ini jebol... hanya soal waktu sebelum Mangi Security menemukan pembangkit listrik termalnya...

column1: Without the Commander, can I really keep the Doll Community safe?
column2: Tanpa Commander, apa aku benar-benar bisa menjaga Doll Community tetap aman?

column1: (The next second, Ullrid only feels someone grabbing her shoulders and then forcefully lifting her up.)
column2: (Sedetik kemudian, Ullrid hanya merasakan seseorang mencengkeram kedua bahunya lalu mengangkatnya kuat-kuat.)

column1: Y-y-you can do it!
column2: K-k-kau bisa!

column1: The Commander believes in you!
column2: Commander percaya padamu!

column1: W-we are too!
column2: K-kami juga!

column1: I... we, together—
column2: Aku... kita, bersama-sama—

column1: (Facing Littara's firm gaze, Ullrid closes her eyes, and when she opens them again, there is no longer any hesitation.)
column2: (Menghadapi tatapan mantap Littara, Ullrid menutup matanya, dan saat membukanya kembali, tidak ada lagi keraguan.)

column1: ...Yeah, really, what kind of spineless things am I saying.
column2: ...Iya, yang benar saja, aku ini bicara hal yang tidak bernyali sekali.

column1: We had been fighting long before the Commander came to the Doll Community.
column2: Kita sudah bertarung jauh sebelum Commander datang ke Doll Community.

column1: As long as we are all still together, there's nothing to be afraid of.
column2: Selama kita semua masih bersama, tidak ada yang perlu ditakuti.

column1: Sorry, I wavered again.
column2: Maaf, aku goyah lagi.

column1: No matter how many times you waver, I will pull you back. — Littara
column2: Sebanyak apa pun kau goyah, aku akan menarikmu kembali. — Littara

column1: As expected of Littara.
column2: Memang Littara.

column1: (Ullrid smiled and stood up.)
column2: (Ullrid tersenyum lalu berdiri.)

column1: Let's go to the frontline command center and continue executing our mission.
column2: Ayo ke pusat komando garis depan dan lanjutkan pelaksanaan misi kita.

column1: 情况如何？
column2: Bagaimana situasinya?

column1: Ah, Big Sis! We've already had the Porcelain squad evacuate the Underground Brokers trading in the town and friendly civilians from other Yellow Zone settlements in advance.
column2: Ah, Big Sis! Kami sudah menyuruh regu Porcelain mengevakuasi Underground Brokers yang berdagang di kota ini dan warga sipil sekutu dari permukiman Yellow Zone lain lebih dulu.

column1: All civilian Dolls unable to participate in combat have also returned to the thermal power plant. The thermal power plant has now fully entered silent mode. Everyone is hiding in the underground safe houses, temporarily shutting down all signals that might expose them.
column2: Semua Doll sipil yang tidak bisa ikut bertempur juga sudah kembali ke pembangkit listrik termal. Pembangkitnya sekarang sepenuhnya masuk mode senyap. Semuanya bersembunyi di safe house bawah tanah, sementara mematikan semua sinyal yang bisa membocorkan posisi.

column1: The Interrupter squad has completed the deployment along the line from Zone D to Zone F in Pradaja. Combined with the news from the front lines, the deployed anti-tank mines should be able to cause a 3% destruction rate and serve to delay the offensive...
column2: Regu Interrupter sudah menyelesaikan penempatan di sepanjang garis dari Zona D ke Zona F di Pradaja. Digabung dengan kabar dari garis depan, ranjau antitank yang dipasang seharusnya bisa menimbulkan tingkat kehancuran 3% dan berfungsi memperlambat serangannya...

column1: Y-yes, sir...
column2: B-benar...

column1: (The Doll in front of her reveals a hint of unease in her tone. Littara steps forward and looks at the densely packed electronic screens.)
column2: (Doll di depannya memperlihatkan sedikit kegelisahan dalam nadanya. Littara melangkah maju dan menatap layar-layar elektronik yang berjejal.)

column1: 3% is already a very ideal state. —Littara
column2: 3% sudah kondisi yang sangat ideal. —Littara

column1: ...How is the Limonad Squad?
column2: ...Bagaimana Limonad Squad?

column1: They are driving vehicles to reconnoiter the front lines and have already located the enemy's armored forces.
column2: Mereka mengendarai kendaraan untuk mengintai garis depan dan sudah menemukan posisi pasukan lapis baja musuh.

column1: Captain Taren just sent a message asking if we should launch an ambush against the enemy's armored units.
column2: Captain Taren baru mengirim pesan bertanya apakah kita perlu menyergap unit lapis baja musuh.

column1: (On the screen, the squad icons representing the Doll squads are flashing, flickering in Ullrid's pupils as well.)
column2: (Di layar, ikon-ikon yang melambangkan regu Doll berkelip, berkelip juga di pupil Ullrid.)

column1: (Ullrid remains silent, thinking.)
column2: (Ullrid tetap diam, berpikir.)

column1: Ullrid, are you thinking the same thing I am? — Littara
column2: Ullrid, kau memikirkan hal yang sama denganku? — Littara

column1: If the Limonad Squad launches an attack, we might be able to destroy one or two enemy vehicles.
column2: Kalau Limonad Squad menyerang, kita mungkin bisa menghancurkan satu atau dua kendaraan musuh.

column1: But on the great plains, the Limonad Squad will definitely be exposed... Our vehicles aren't very fast... It will be very difficult for them to evacuate from there.
column2: Tapi di dataran luas itu, Limonad Squad pasti terbongkar... Kendaraan kita tidak cepat... Akan sangat sulit bagi mereka untuk mundur dari sana.

column1: Are we going to start a war here... but here...
column2: Apa kita akan memulai perangnya di sini... tapi di sini...

column1: (Her voice reveals unease.)
column2: (Suaranya memperlihatkan kegelisahan.)

column1: If we do this, our losses will indeed be incalculable. — Littara
column2: Kalau kita melakukannya, kerugian kita memang tidak akan terhitung. — Littara

column1: (Ullrid looks around the command room.)
column2: (Ullrid memandang sekeliling ruang komando.)

column1: (This room wasn't originally a command room, just the basement of an ordinary civilian house in Pradaja.)
column2: (Ruangan ini semula bukan ruang komando, hanya ruang bawah tanah sebuah rumah warga biasa di Pradaja.)

column1: (The central console, projection screens, battlefield sandbox, war terminals... so much equipment. After gradually accumulating some savings, they searched everywhere, slowly gathered it all, and moved it here bit by bit from the thermal power plant.)
column2: (Konsol pusat, layar proyeksi, meja pasir medan tempur, terminal perang... begitu banyak perangkat. Setelah perlahan mengumpulkan sedikit tabungan, mereka mencari ke mana-mana, mengumpulkannya pelan-pelan, dan memindahkannya sedikit demi sedikit dari pembangkit listrik termal.)

column1: (In just a few months, with the Commander's help, the construction speed of Pradaja far exceeded imagination. For the Doll Community, this town is a trade hub, an external diplomatic node, and the last barrier for the thermal power plant.)
column2: (Hanya dalam beberapa bulan, dengan bantuan Commander, kecepatan pembangunan Pradaja jauh melampaui bayangan. Bagi Doll Community, kota ini adalah pusat perdagangan, simpul diplomasi luar, dan penghalang terakhir bagi pembangkit listrik termal.)

column1: Pradaja is an important part of the Doll Community... but we have an even more important place.
column2: Pradaja adalah bagian penting Doll Community... tapi kita punya tempat yang lebih penting lagi.

column1: In the deep rear of Pradaja, is the oasis we found in the vast desert, belonging exclusively to us.
column2: Jauh di belakang Pradaja, ada oasis yang kita temukan di gurun yang luas, yang sepenuhnya milik kita.

column1: (The attention of the Dolls in the command room is drawn to Ullrid.)
column2: (Perhatian para Doll di ruang komando tertarik ke Ullrid.)

column1: In the past, we couldn't repair our companions, couldn't keep everyone awake, and couldn't find the possibility of survival.
column2: Dulu kita tidak bisa memperbaiki rekan-rekan kita, tidak bisa menjaga semuanya tetap sadar, dan tidak bisa menemukan kemungkinan untuk bertahan hidup.

column1: Until we found that thermal power plant, where we gained a shelter, welcomed new companions, and encountered our most important ally, mentor, and guide—the Commander.
column2: Sampai kita menemukan pembangkit listrik termal itu, tempat kita mendapat naungan, menyambut rekan-rekan baru, dan berjumpa dengan sekutu, mentor, serta pembimbing terpenting kita—Commander.

column1: To be honest, I cannot understand human politics... and human struggles are difficult for me to fathom.
column2: Sejujurnya, aku tidak bisa memahami politik manusia... dan pergulatan manusia sulit kucerna.

column1: But I know that the thermal power plant is our home, an important defense line for the Commander, and the shared hope of the Commander and us.
column2: Tapi aku tahu pembangkit listrik termal itu adalah rumah kita, garis pertahanan penting bagi Commander, dan harapan bersama Commander dan kita.

column1: In this world, as Dolls, we don't have many opportunities to change our fate...
column2: Di dunia ini, sebagai Doll, kita tidak punya banyak kesempatan mengubah takdir kita...

column1: If I have to make a bet, I'm willing to place all my stakes on the Commander.
column2: Kalau aku harus bertaruh, aku bersedia menaruh seluruh taruhanku pada Commander.

column1: ...Everyone, are you willing to join me?
column2: ...Semuanya, kalian bersedia ikut bersamaku?

column1: (Ullrid spoke every word with resounding force.)
column2: (Ullrid mengucapkan setiap katanya dengan tenaga yang bergaung.)

column1: (The command room, which originally had a somewhat depressed atmosphere, seems to boil up in this instant as if injected with carbonated drinks.)
column2: (Ruang komando yang suasananya semula agak muram itu seolah mendidih seketika seperti disuntik minuman berkarbonasi.)

column1: Yes! As long as we are with the Commander! We will definitely be able to overcome this crisis!
column2: Ya! Selama kita bersama Commander! Kita pasti bisa melewati krisis ini!

column1: Ullrid is right!
column2: Ullrid benar!

column1: The Commander will definitely return, so we must protect the Doll Community!
column2: Commander pasti kembali, jadi kita harus melindungi Doll Community!

column1: Maybe, if we defend this place well, we can make the Commander look at us in a new light.
column2: Mungkin, kalau kita mempertahankan tempat ini dengan baik, Commander akan memandang kita dengan cara baru.

column1: I still remember how helpless the Commander looked when seeing our plantation plan for the first time.
column2: Aku masih ingat betapa tak berdayanya wajah Commander saat pertama kali melihat rencana perkebunan kita.

column1: Waaah...
column2: Huwaaa...

column1: Hehehe, since everyone can reach a consensus... we built this town, and we need to make good use of every brick and tile here.
column2: Hehehe, karena semuanya sudah sepakat... kita yang membangun kota ini, dan kita harus memanfaatkan setiap batu dan gentingnya dengan baik.

column1: The enemy's attack routes are limited. Use the traps we deployed in advance... to stall the enemy's advance in Pradaja!
column2: Rute serangan musuh terbatas. Pakai jebakan yang sudah kita pasang... untuk menghambat kemajuan musuh di Pradaja!

column1: (Suddenly, the sound of an alarm rings abruptly in the command room. Red markers representing enemies appear on the map on the screen, flashing with a dangerous and glaring light.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba bunyi alarm menyalak di ruang komando. Penanda merah yang melambangkan musuh muncul di peta pada layar, berkelip dengan cahaya yang berbahaya dan menyilaukan.)

column1: They've appeared! Unidentified units with unregistered identification codes, a lot of them! The enemy has already broken into the outermost Alpha alert zone... The subsequent numbers haven't been fully tallied yet, estimated to enter the anti-tank mine area in 20 minutes.
column2: Mereka muncul! Unit tak dikenal dengan kode identifikasi tidak terdaftar, jumlahnya banyak! Musuh sudah menerobos zona peringatan Alpha paling luar... Jumlah selanjutnya belum selesai dihitung, diperkirakan masuk area ranjau antitank dalam 20 menit.

column1: Bring up the image.
column2: Tampilkan citranya.

column1: (The image of the unknown unit was brought up and projected onto the sandbox.)
column2: (Citra unit tak dikenal itu ditampilkan dan diproyeksikan ke meja pasirnya.)

column1: 'It overlaps with the enemy footage transmitted by Robella. Ullrid! It's time to predict!' — Littara
column2: 'Ini cocok dengan rekaman musuh yang dikirim Robella. Ullrid! Waktunya memprediksi!' — Littara

column1: The flames of war have spread over here.
column2: Kobaran perang sudah menjalar sampai ke sini.

column1: Notify everyone, the operation begins.
column2: Beri tahu semuanya, operasi dimulai.

column1: For the future of the Commander and the Doll Community!
column2: Untuk masa depan Commander dan Doll Community!

column1: (The thermal power plant where the Doll Community is located is too conspicuous and has shown signs of almost being exposed in the past. Although the supporting facilities are very complete, it is not suitable as a bridgehead for defense.)
column2: (Pembangkit listrik termal tempat Doll Community berada terlalu kentara dan pernah hampir terbongkar. Meski fasilitas pendukungnya sangat lengkap, tempat itu tidak cocok jadi kepala jembatan pertahanan.)

column1: (In the Commander's plan, as long as this place doesn't fall, it can firmly attract the enemy's attention and ensure the survival of the thermal power plant.)
column2: (Dalam rencana Commander, selama tempat ini tidak jatuh, ia bisa menarik perhatian musuh dengan kuat dan menjamin kelangsungan pembangkit listrik termalnya.)

column1: (As the leader of the Doll Community, Ullrid deeply felt her own powerlessness, and this operation would be launched without the Commander's assistance.)
column2: (Sebagai pemimpin Doll Community, Ullrid sangat merasakan ketidakberdayaannya sendiri, dan operasi ini akan dijalankan tanpa bantuan Commander.)

column1: (The Limonad Squad is the ace anti-armor team in the Doll Community. If they are rashly consumed here, it is absolutely not worth it tactically. The enemy's advance force is mainly composed of heavy armored units, supplemented by human troops. Therefore, the layout here must be readjusted according to the strategy previously left by the Commander.)
column2: (Limonad Squad adalah regu antiarmor andalan Doll Community. Kalau mereka dihabiskan sembarangan di sini, secara taktis itu sama sekali tidak sepadan. Pasukan pendahulu musuh terutama terdiri dari unit lapis baja berat, ditambah pasukan manusia. Karena itu susunan di sini harus disetel ulang menurut strategi yang ditinggalkan Commander.)

column1: (Ullrid reached out and pulled up a blueprint named 'Operation Plan 09' from the virtual sandbox. This was a deployment left by the Commander before heading to Mokosh, an interception tactic designed to counter the enemy armored forces attacking Pradaja if Mokosh fell.)
column2: (Ullrid mengulurkan tangan dan menarik sebuah cetak biru bernama 'Operation Plan 09' dari meja pasir virtual. Itu penempatan yang ditinggalkan Commander sebelum berangkat ke Mokosh, taktik pencegatan yang dirancang untuk melawan pasukan lapis baja musuh yang menyerang Pradaja kalau Mokosh jatuh.)

column1: (This map was marked with dense firepower deployment points, perfectly integrating the ruins on the outskirts of Pradaja, naturally formed landforms, and trench fortifications dug long ago, weaving them into death traps capable of swallowing steel behemoths.)
column2: (Peta itu dipenuhi tanda titik penempatan daya tembak, memadukan dengan sempurna puing di pinggiran Pradaja, bentang alam yang terbentuk alami, dan parit pertahanan yang sudah lama digali, merajutnya jadi jebakan mati yang mampu menelan raksasa baja.)

column1: (That's right, this was completely different from the war of attrition in Mokosh relying on the dome and solid fortifications. This was a cruel war of attrition tactic of setting up layers of ambushes at all costs, even trading Doll Frames for enemy armor.)
column2: (Benar, ini sepenuhnya berbeda dari perang gerus di Mokosh yang mengandalkan kubah dan benteng kokoh. Ini taktik perang gerus yang kejam: memasang sergapan berlapis dengan segala cara, bahkan menukar Frame Doll dengan armor musuh.)

column1: (And at this moment, deployed at these meat grinder firepower points were the long-time companions of the Doll Community. Although they didn't have fire control cores or high-performance military weapons, as long as they launched surprise attacks at extremely close range with simple anti-armor rocket launchers, they could definitely tear through the enemy's armor defenses.)
column2: (Dan saat itu, yang ditempatkan di titik-titik daya tembak penggiling daging itu adalah rekan-rekan lama Doll Community. Meski mereka tidak punya inti kendali tembakan atau senjata militer berperforma tinggi, selama mereka menyerang mendadak dari jarak sangat dekat dengan peluncur roket antiarmor sederhana, mereka pasti bisa mencabik pertahanan armor musuh.)

column1: (Once this place falls, the thermal power plant will definitely be exposed, and the fate of the Dolls and civilians relying on it will be unimaginable.)
column2: (Begitu tempat ini jatuh, pembangkit listrik termalnya pasti terbongkar, dan nasib para Doll serta warga sipil yang bergantung padanya tidak terbayangkan.)

column1: (Yellow sand swirled as Mangi Security's mechanized advance force formed a standard tactical wedge formation, their tracks mercilessly crushing the parched earth as they slowly advanced towards their target—Paradajz.)
column2: (Pasir kuning berpusar saat pasukan pendahulu mekanis Mangi Security membentuk formasi pasak taktis standar, rantai roda mereka menggencet tanah kering tanpa ampun sembari perlahan maju ke sasaran—Paradajz.)

column1: (The entire comms channel was dead silent. Aside from the low roar of the engines and the heavy breathing inside the armored vehicles, there was no other noise. This was not just strict marching discipline, but an indescribable pre-battle oppression.)
column2: (Seluruh saluran komunikasi sunyi total. Selain gemuruh rendah mesin dan napas berat di dalam kendaraan lapis baja, tidak ada suara lain. Ini bukan cuma disiplin gerak yang ketat, tapi tekanan pra-tempur yang tak bisa dijelaskan.)

column1: (Now, their destination was a town built with Dolls as its absolute core. The thought of possibly having to face that kind of terrifying close-quarters combat and house-to-house fighting again made every member of Mangi Security feel a trace of fear.)
column2: (Sekarang tujuan mereka adalah kota yang dibangun dengan Doll sebagai inti mutlaknya. Memikirkan kemungkinan harus kembali menghadapi pertempuran jarak dekat dan pertarungan rumah ke rumah yang mengerikan itu membuat setiap anggota Mangi Security merasakan sedikit rasa takut.)

column1: (Following the orders issued by the rear command center, their tactics as the vanguard spearhead were extremely conservative: never blindly advance deep, but simply utilize the open field of vision of the plain terrain, relying on the high mobility and long-range heavy firepower of the armored cluster to implement one-way suppressive fire on that 'Paradajz'.)
column2: (Mengikuti perintah dari pusat komando belakang, taktik mereka sebagai ujung tombak sangat konservatif: jangan pernah menerobos dalam secara buta, cukup manfaatkan bidang pandang terbuka medan dataran, mengandalkan mobilitas tinggi dan daya tembak berat jarak jauh gugus lapis baja untuk melakukan tembakan penekan satu arah ke 'Paradajz' itu.)

column1: (However, on the ever-changing battlefield, this excessive caution and hesitation turned into a death warrant of their own making.)
column2: (Namun di medan tempur yang terus berubah, kehati-hatian dan keraguan yang berlebihan itu berubah menjadi surat kematian buatan mereka sendiri.)

column1: (*BOOM—*)
column2: (*DUAR—*)

column1: (A deafening explosion tore through the dead silence of the wilderness. A blinding crimson fireball instantly erupted from the bottom of the infantry fighting vehicle charging at the very front. Immediately after, the ammunition inside the vehicle suffered a tragic sympathetic detonation. The turret was blown several meters into the air by the violent blast wave like a rag, turning into a burning rain of steel and fire crashing down all around.)
column2: (Ledakan yang memekakkan mencabik kesunyian mati belantara itu. Bola api merah tua yang menyilaukan seketika meletus dari bagian bawah kendaraan tempur infanteri yang menerjang paling depan. Sesaat kemudian amunisi di dalam kendaraan itu ikut meledak dengan tragis. Turetnya terlempar beberapa meter ke udara oleh gelombang ledakan yang ganas seperti kain lap, berubah menjadi hujan baja dan api yang berjatuhan di sekitarnya.)

column1: (The smoke of gunpowder has yet to dissipate. Behind a low cover less than fifty meters from the wreckage, a petite T-Doll slowly leans half her body out. On her slender shoulder rests a man-portable recoilless rifle that is completely disproportionate to her size, its muzzle emitting wisps of pungent white smoke.)
column2: (Asap mesiu belum hilang. Di balik penutup rendah kurang dari lima puluh meter dari bangkai itu, seorang T-Doll bertubuh kecil perlahan menjulurkan separuh badannya. Di bahunya yang mungil bertumpu senapan tanpa tolak-balik jinjing yang sama sekali tidak sepadan dengan ukurannya, ujung larasnya mengepulkan asap putih yang menyengat.)

column1: (Facing the turning gun barrel of the Mangi Security combat vehicle, not a trace of fear flickers in her pupils, only the determination to fight the enemy to the death.)
column2: (Menghadapi laras kendaraan tempur Mangi Security yang berputar ke arahnya, tidak ada setitik rasa takut pun berkelip di pupilnya, hanya tekad bertarung sampai mati.)

column1: (Dakka-dakka-dakka—)
column2: (Ratatatata—)

column1: (The muzzle flash of the vehicle-mounted autocannon instantly destroys this Doll's Frame.)
column2: (Kilatan laras autocannon kendaraan itu seketika menghancurkan Frame Doll tersebut.)

column1: (But this insignificant victory does not elicit any cheers from the members of Mangi Security, because they have already realized that the true nightmare has arrived.)
column2: (Tapi kemenangan yang tak berarti itu tidak membuat anggota Mangi Security bersorak, karena mereka sudah menyadari mimpi buruk yang sesungguhnya sudah datang.)

column1: (Inside Mangi Security's underground command center, the glaring red battle damage alarms cast flickering shadows on Lentine's face. On the holographic tactical sandbox, the light dots representing the vanguard forces have all extinguished.)
column2: (Di pusat komando bawah tanah Mangi Security, alarm kerusakan tempur berwarna merah menyala melempar bayangan yang berkelip di wajah Lentine. Di meja pasir taktis holografis, titik-titik cahaya yang melambangkan pasukan pendahulu sudah mati semua.)

column1: (To paralyze the five heavy combat vehicles of the vanguard forces, the enemy actually only sacrificed a little over ten Doll Frames.)
column2: (Untuk melumpuhkan lima kendaraan tempur berat pasukan pendahulu, musuh ternyata hanya mengorbankan sedikit di atas sepuluh Frame Doll.)

column1: (And the subsequent support troops happened to step right onto the anti-tank minefield deployed by the enemy, destroying another combat vehicle.)
column2: (Dan pasukan pendukung berikutnya justru melangkah tepat ke ladang ranjau antitank yang dipasang musuh, menghancurkan satu kendaraan tempur lagi.)

column1: (Lentine stares fixedly at the tactical map, falling into a suffocating silence. She realizes that she seems to have once again stepped into a bloody trap that had been laid out long ago.)
column2: (Lentine menatap lekat peta taktisnya, jatuh ke kesunyian yang menyesakkan. Dia menyadari sepertinya dia kembali melangkah ke jebakan berdarah yang sudah lama dipasang.)

column1: (Let alone a dozen Doll Frames, even fifty of these old Frames wouldn't come close to the cost of a single Mangi Security heavy combat vehicle. Yet the enemy is using this pure war of attrition to coldly bleed Mangi Security dry. Just how many Doll Frames does the enemy have in reserve? How long will this despair-inducing exchange tactic continue?)
column2: (Jangan bicara belasan Frame Doll, lima puluh Frame tua seperti itu pun tidak akan mendekati harga satu kendaraan tempur berat Mangi Security. Tapi musuh memakai perang gerus murni itu untuk mengeringkan Mangi Security dengan dingin. Sebenarnya berapa banyak Frame Doll yang dicadangkan musuh? Sampai kapan taktik tukar-tambah yang membuat putus asa ini berlanjut?)

column1: (Anger and unwillingness make the knuckles of Lentine's fingers gripping the terminal turn white. Such a terrifying battle damage ratio, such tactical execution—no one other than that Commander could have formulated this. And the biggest problem is whether he is actually here or not, and whether her counter-tactics can be effective.)
column2: (Kemarahan dan ketidakrelaan membuat sendi jari Lentine yang mencengkeram terminal memutih. Rasio kerusakan tempur yang mengerikan itu, eksekusi taktis seperti itu—tidak ada selain Commander itu yang bisa menyusunnya. Dan masalah terbesarnya adalah apakah dia benar-benar ada di sini atau tidak, dan apakah taktik penangkalnya bisa berhasil.)

column1: (After thinking it over again and again, Lentine takes a deep breath. The apprehension in her eyes gradually fades, replaced by a cold sneer mixed with madness and ruthlessness. Rather than sitting and waiting for death, it's better to take the initiative and attack.)
column2: (Setelah menimbangnya berkali-kali, Lentine menarik napas panjang. Kegelisahan di matanya berangsur memudar, digantikan cemoohan dingin yang bercampur kegilaan dan kekejaman. Daripada duduk menunggu mati, lebih baik mengambil inisiatif dan menyerang.)

column1: (In that nightmarish encounter in Mokosh, those T-Dolls shuttling between buildings like ghosts, fighting relentlessly to the death, had long since carved a deep brand named "meat grinder" onto the nerves of these mercenaries.)
column2: (Dalam perjumpaan bak mimpi buruk di Mokosh itu, T-Doll yang berpindah di antara bangunan seperti hantu dan bertarung tanpa henti sampai mati sudah lama mengukir cap mendalam bernama "penggiling daging" di saraf para tentara bayaran itu.)

column1: (They used modified suicide drones, man-portable recoilless rifles, and even directly placed plastic explosives on the chassis and tracks of combat vehicles. With an almost insane "exchange" tactic, they launched pervasive swarm attacks from every blind spot in the shadows, trenches, natural covers, and ruins, slowly gnawing away the vanguard forces bit by bit.)
column2: (Mereka memakai drone bunuh diri hasil modifikasi, senapan tanpa tolak-balik jinjing, bahkan langsung menempelkan peledak plastik ke sasis dan rantai roda kendaraan tempur. Dengan taktik "tukar" yang nyaris gila, mereka melancarkan serangan kawanan dari setiap titik buta di bayangan, parit, penutup alami, dan puing, menggerogoti pasukan pendahulu sedikit demi sedikit.)
